ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with location allowed "While using", open Explore, go a few kilometres, then open Plan an outing and an area card's "Suggest a walk"; then, indoors with no fix, open either within half an hour of Explore's last fix and again after it; then turn location off for Chronicles and open either. **Expect:** each page says "Finding you…", then plans around where the phone is now (its dot there) and Start routes from there; with no fix in ten seconds, the plan from the earlier fix with "From where you were … minutes ago.", and past half an hour "Needs your location…" with nothing proposed; with location off, that line and "Location is turned off for Chronicles. Turn it on in Settings to find your position.", nothing proposed and no dot (fix outing-current-position, decision 0273; `usePagePosition`, `locate/index.native.ts` with `fresh`).
